front: Disarm a trap or other complex device with a Thievery check. Complex devices may need multiple successes.
back:
Thievery check; a thieves' toolkit may be required, and some devices need higher Thievery proficiency.
Crit Success: disable it (or 2 successes toward a multi-success device) with no trace; you can rearm it later if it can be rearmed.
Success: disable it, or 1 success toward a multi-success device.
Crit Failure: you trigger the device.
